title: Red Deer Lions Campground
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Located in the heart of Red Deer, combines the beauty of a park with the convenience of the city. The Red Deer River provides a striking backdrop to the campground, and campers are welcome to enjoy the expansive trail system that winds its way along the scenic waterway. Campground recreation opportunities include trails, a private entrance to the Trans-Canada Trail/river system and playgrounds.
